scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:bundle: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS'
